pin.estimand: token_delta of by-construction/by-rule/in-practice marked forms versus the complete careful-English regime clauses they replace; sixteen pairs (by-construction 6 oversampled for its mechanism clause, by-rule 5, in-practice 5) across domains disjoint from the original sixteen (ledger, broker, audit storage, token verifier, ring buffer, consensus; exports, indentation, postmortems, CI credentials, schema review; builds, timeouts, cache, deploys, failover), written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original set (619971d5)
admissibility_gates: regime_honesty: by-construction english arms carry the mechanism clause ('cannot occur while the system stands unchanged'); by-rule arms carry the standing rule plus a named owner; in-practice arms carry only the observed regularity; a pair missing its regime's clause aborts
form_coverage: by-construction contributes six pairs, by-rule and in-practice five each; a missing or empty form aborts

test_set.english: The ledger balances on every write because the transaction layer commits debit and credit atomically; an unbalanced entry cannot occur while the system stands unchanged.
A message cannot be replayed because the broker discards duplicates by sequence number at the partition level.
The audit log cannot be edited after close because the storage bucket is write-once and the writer holds no update permission.
test_set.ainglish: The audit log is immutable by-construction.

test_set.english: An expired token cannot authenticate because the verifier checks the timestamp before any claim is read.
The queue cannot deliver past its depth bound because the ring buffer overwrites only after an acknowledgement is recorded.
A fork cannot spend the same output twice because consensus rejects any block whose inputs are already spent.
A standing policy requires every export to be encrypted; a plaintext export can occur and its owner owes the repair.
House style requires two-space indentation; a tab-indented file can land and its committer owes the fix.
The incident process requires a postmortem within five days; a missing postmortem is possible and the on-call owes it.
A standing rule forbids production credentials in CI; a leaked credential can occur and the pipeline owner owes its rotation.
The review charter requires a security sign-off on schema changes; an unsigned change can ship and the approver owes the explanation.
Every observed build has completed in under ten minutes; nothing prevents a slower one.
test_set.ainglish: Builds finish in under ten minutes in-practice.

test_set.english: Every response observed so far has arrived before the timeout; nothing forbids a late one.
test_set.ainglish: Responses arrive before the timeout in-practice.

test_set.english: The cache has hit on every sampled request this week; a miss would be news, not a violation.
Every deploy observed this quarter has been reversible; nothing claimed prevents an irreversible one.
The failover has completed cleanly in every drill to date; a failed failover would be a finding, not a breach.

manifest.method: delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair; per-tokenizer value = mean over sixteen pairs (by-construction 6 oversampled for its mechanism clause, by-rule 5, in-practice 5); reported value = floor across tokenizer lineages. Contract-prerequisite reading: marked form vs the complete careful-English regime clause it replaces. tiktoken 0.14.0.
